description: This file defines the AuditTrailContentHandler class, which manages audit trail events for content items in OrchardCore, including handling creation, publishing, restoring, and removal events, and recording audit trail entries.

classes.name: AuditTrailContentHandler
classes.description: Handles content events to record audit trail entries, including creation, publishing, restoring, and removal of content items.

methods.name: AuditTrailContentHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for audit trail handling.

methods.name: DraftSavedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when a draft is saved, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: CreatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is created, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is published, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is unpublished, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is removed, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: ClonedAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is cloned, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: RestoringAsync
methods.description: Handles the restoring process of content, tracking restoring state.

methods.name: RestoredAsync
methods.description: Handles the event when content is restored, recording an audit trail event.

methods.name: RecordAuditTrailEventAsync
methods.description: Internal method to record an audit trail event for a specific content item and event type.
